Overview

Santo André is a city in SP with a population of 723,889. An industrial and commercial hub in Greater São Paulo, known for its parks, cultural centers, and the historic Paranapiacaba village. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees.
